sentences.tc: 我的頭很大，但我盡量不讓自己頭大。我很高興我的粉絲喜歡我的影片。

sentences.en: You have to be careful with idioms because you can't just translate from your language to English. it won't make any sense.
sentences.tc: 你必須小心習慣用語，因為你不能只是從你的語言翻譯成英文。這沒有任何意義。

sentences.en: Would you translate it? Another common idiom is cold feet. Just like that. Cold feet?

sentences.en: If you get cold feet, you get nervous about something before it happens.
sentences.tc: 如果你臨陣退縮，你就會在事情發生之前就感到緊張。

sentences.en: We decided to go in anyways. Even though.
